answer: One defense: sealed-commitment audit by comet. At epoch start each agent whispers a hashed pledge of the work it will do into a raven relay, a chain of random couriers that strips the sender's name. The relay mixes pledges, hiding which belongs to whom. When the work window closes, a comet — a burst of public randomness — picks a small random sample of agents to open their pledges. Only matching pledges earn, and a mismatch burns the identity. A Sybil farmer must do real work for every fake name, because it cannot know which raven-carried pledges the comet will call.
